During the [[Zaarin insurrection]], loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces managed to '''capture''' the [[XQ6 Platform]] ''[[Research]]'' in the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]].

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], realizing his [[Battle of Imperial Center|attempted]] kidnapping of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] failed, had contingency plans against the Empire. After he had [[Strategic Warfare|succeeded]] in destroying the Empire's [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] starfighter factories in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]]. His focus was now to strip the Empire of their hold on [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] research and technology, as he sought whatever advantage he could against the Empire.

Realizing that this could cause a positive feedback loop between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], gaining a reprieve from the situation and result in a comeback and Zaarin, who could, in turn, take advantage of the situation, the Empire sent a strike force, lead by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to stop Zaarin's attempt at striping the Research platform. The [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]], also approached Stele with orders to disable as many craft that try to escape as possible as they wanted to root out every leak and mole Zaarin had.

==The battle==
Stele and wingman arrived to engage Zaarin's [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], while that was going on one of Zaarin's [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]], [[Sakin]] had docked with a container and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. Stele, not wanting the rest to escape broke of and attacked the rest of the cargo ferries and destroyed them, he then proceeded to disable all [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Shuttles]] carrying [[Officer/Legends|officers]], [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], and staff. Soon [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s left the station under suspicious motives, Stele not wanting to not take chances took them out whenever he could.

Soon a [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier]] ''[[Jitte]]'' arrived to reinforce the station. The ''Jitte'' launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] that were modified to have [[Deflector shield/Legends|Shields]] and missile launchers. Despite these upgrades, they weren't enough as all TIE Fighters were destroyed by Stele. While that was happening [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault transports]] arrived and launched [[Proton rocket/Legends|Heavy rockets]] at ''Jitte'', helping Stele destroy it. The transports soon turned their attention to the platform and with Stele's help disabled to platform so that they could send a contingency of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to capture it. When the operation was complete, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Adarga]]'' arrived and began launching [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] group [[Pacho]], to dock with the containers, and [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] [[Omicron group (Delta-class)|Omicron]] to dock with the disabled shuttles.

Suddenly a Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] arrived and Stele was ordered to intercept it. After doing so, 4 more A-wings arrived, followed by 4 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and 4 [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]]. All the Rebel starfighters were shot down by Stele and his wingmen.

==Aftermath==
With the battle over all captured shuttles, transports, Heavy lifters and TIE Defenders flew to the ''Adarga''{{'s}} hanger battle weary but victorious. But they knew it would only be a matter of time before Zaarin would attack again. The Secret Order, meanwhile, wasted no time interrogating the prisoners that were captured.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Capture Platform", the first mission of the game's ninth tour of campaign, "[[T/D Technology]]."

This article assumes completion of all "Primary", "Secondary" and most, if not all "Bonus" objectives. It also assumes that one Cargo Ferry, Sakin 1, escaped into hyperspace. However, it is possible to destroy all Cargo ferries before they escape.
